claims: In 2026, Mother's Day (or Mothering Sunday) in the UK is celebrated on Sunday, March 15.
Mother's Day in the UK in 2027 is on March 7.
In the UK, Mother's Day falls on the fourth Sunday of Lent.
Mother's Day originated as a medieval Christian tradition where people visited their "mother church" during Lent.
A "mother church" is the main church in their area.
Time and Date says UK Mother's Day has evolved into a secular celebration similar to the US, often called "Mother's Day."
English Heritage says common traditions include giving gifts (flowers, chocolates), hosting afternoon teas, and families getting together to "spoil" mothers.
Wikipedia says the date shifts every year based on the church calendar.
